  --body-file - \
  --head "work/decompose-next-disclosure" <<EOF
## Summary

- Bring the `decompose-next` skill package onto the merged seven-kind and Probe methodology, so a projection it produces classifies verification the way the chapters now do.
- Move the decomposition design and its open discriminator out of `versions/next/` into the knowledge bundle, where dated rationale belongs.

## Background

The package transcribed the methodology as it stood before PR #49: two verdict modes, a node-level judged result named Trial, and a package at `trials/trial.md`. The merged chapters carry six types over three verdict modes, name the attested result Probe, and fix its package at `probes/`. A projection built from the old transcription would classify verification by a retired vocabulary and instruct authoring at a path the methodology does not name.

Two changes go beyond renaming. Probe is required at every tier rather than at prototype alone, so rows that scoped the requirement to prototype receivers now cover every output receiver — a tree omitting `probes/` reaches Passing nowhere. And ownership for pruning follows a live Probe implementation list alone: Test, Evaluate, and current Audit paths expose implementation to verification without declaring ownership, so `structural-quality.md` gains that as a validity check rather than leaving a projection to argue retention from evidence reach.

The coordination note recording the template design failed the Durable Truth Boundary's completion test by its own admission — its entries resolve by being written into a chapter — and that rule exempts no artifact class. The content moves to `knowledge/outcome-engineering/`, where the reading status can state plainly that it carries no authority.

## Changes

- `references/tier-and-state.md` — three verdict modes, the six-type table, the Probe package contract and frontmatter coverage declaration, the pin rule, the per-tier requirement, Validate as a changeset gate, and the merge-state rule.
- `references/toolchain-limits.md` — the Probe rows split a measured signal from an unmeasured one; the file's own use of "probe" for a measurement yields to the verification type.
- `references/structural-quality.md` — a pruning-ownership validity check mapped to Reconcile continuously.
- `references/projection-views.md`, `workflows/*` — Probe vocabulary and output-receiver scope.
- `scripts/remeasure.sh` — measures `probes/`, `probe.md`, and `attestation`; drops "probe" as a measurement noun.
- `knowledge/outcome-engineering/decomposition-templates.md` — the design, with `versions/next/ISSUES.md` removed.

## Test plan

- [ ] `git diff --check origin/main..HEAD` reports nothing.
- [ ] The mirrored-skill check from `CLAUDE.md` passes; `decompose-next` lives only under `.claude/skills/` because it binds the Claude-only skill-directory token.
- [ ] `bash .claude/skills/decompose-next/scripts/remeasure.sh` exits zero and reproduces the toolchain rows, including zero occurrences of `probes/`, `probe.md`, and `attestation`.
- [ ] No occurrence of `Trial`, `trials/`, `Computed`, or `Judged` remains in the package.
